notes: The entry's name (unary-binary rooted trees with n nodes) does not determine the data: labelled unordered trees (A036774) differ at n = 3, labelled plane trees (n! Motzkin(n-1)) at n = 4. A029766_data: n! A040039(n-1) = a(n) for all 19 listed n >= 1 (decide; A040039 as first differences of A033485). A029766_main: for n >= 1 the number of unlabelled unary-binary trees with equal branches at every binary node (Set.ncard over an inductive tree type) is A040039(n-1); n! times it matches all data (labelled plane trees with equal-shape branches). Outside Lean: that this family is what Bergeron-Labelle-Leroux p. 254 tabulates (book not checked).

prior_art.note: No definition beyond the name; data match neither standard labelled count. The equal-branch reading reduces to the A040039 recurrence listed by G. Wiseman (2018).
